description: This file is a shell script that sets up a series of Git repository tests, including commits, rebase operations, hook setups, and various test cases for Git hooks and rebase interactions. It appears to be a test harness for Git hook behavior validation.

methods.name: clear_hook_input
methods.description: Removes the hook input files (post-rewrite.args and post-rewrite.data) to reset hook input state.

methods.name: verify_hook_input
methods.description: Compares the current hook input files to the expected files to verify correctness.

methods.name: set_fake_editor
methods.description: Sets the environment to simulate a fake editor for rebase operations.

methods.name: test_rebase
methods.description: A function included from lib-rebase.sh to facilitate rebase testing.

methods.name: test_fail_interactive_rebase
methods.description: Runs an interactive rebase with predefined fake input lines, expecting failure.
